scope: All nine residual vopros-family nouns in the current Latin reader.
choice: Replace type-3 vopros with the type-1 pytańje family in standard project spelling: pytanje, pytanja, pytanjah, and pytanjam, preserving case and sentence function.
motivation: The official dictionary explicitly rates pytańje as type 1 and vȯpros as type 3. Pytańje has independent cognate support in Belarusian, Polish, Ukrainian, Croatian/Serbian, and verbal-root support across Czech/Slovak, while vopros is strongly East/Bulgarian-shaped. The corpus already uses pytanje productively, so this removes needless lexical duplication.
alternatives_rejected: Retain vopros as merely understandable; that preserves a known type-3 dominant-language form despite an exact type-1 alternative.
Use zapytanje everywhere; official pytańje is shorter and already established throughout this reader.
Recast sentences individually when the exact noun paradigm can be normalized without altering syntax or meaning.

validation.cardinality: 9/9 exact whole tokens partitioned by form
validation.structure: TeX controls, references/citations, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
